title: Ethereum bears keep selling but ETH price stays near $2,700 as US spot ETFs record $206M in outflows
summary: Ethereum’s institutional demand is weakening around the same time derivatives positioning shows traders are selling aggressively without yet breaking the broader price structure. US spot ETH exchange-traded funds recorded $50.76 million of net outflows on Oct. 5, extending their losing streak to five consecutive sessions, according to SoSoValue data.
